game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Exit Light Ledge Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the stone seal using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The stone seal reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the stone seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
